title: Chevening Scholarship
excerpt: United Kingdom. Full tuition, stipend and flights.
content:
Full tuition, stipend and flights

The UK government's flagship award for a one-year masters. Requires two years of work experience and demonstrated leadership. Applications open in August and close in early November.

We track this award's deadline against your application timeline and flag it eight weeks ahead, because scholarship deadlines routinely fall before the admission deadlines students are watching.
